text_block_list.text:
Hoppity-jam, floppity-jam! Tell me my
luck for
today's training session...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Huh? "Slow and steady wins the race?!"
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You know what that means! Act like the
old-timey
aristocrats and find the most
auspicious route to
the destination!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
All right, first I need to direct myself to
the most
auspicious coordinates...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Oh! To think such a delightful place
awaits me
beyond my auspicious
orienteering!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect time for a little
breather!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Of course, this doesn't mean having fun
or
anything unbecoming like that! This is
just to
prepare myself for my training!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
